title: AXP Security
description: Security schemas for AXP. AXP uses the same security patterns as UCP: ES256 signatures, JWK public keys, detached JWS (RFC 7797), and standard JWT.

signing_key.title: Signing Key (JWK)
signing_key.description: Public key for signature verification in JWK format. Same format as UCP signing_keys.

signing_keys.title: Signing Keys Array
signing_keys.description: Array of public keys for signature verification.

request_signature.title: Request Signature
request_signature.description: Detached JWS signature for request/response signing (RFC 7797). Format: base64url(header)..base64url(signature). Uses ES256 algorithm (ECDSA P-256 + SHA-256).

jwt.title: JWT Token
jwt.description: Standard JWT token using ES256 algorithm.

alg.description: Signing algorithm. ES256 (P-256) is required for UCP/AXP compatibility.

kid.description: Key ID referencing a key in the signer's signing_keys array.

experience_signature.title: Experience Content Signature
experience_signature.description: Signature for embedded experience content to ensure integrity.

signature.description: Detached JWS signature over the experience bundle hash.

signed_at.description: Timestamp when the content was signed.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the experience bundle (base64url encoded).

agent_header.title: AXP-Agent Header
agent_header.description: Agent identification header for AXP requests. Compatible with UCP-Agent header format.

profile.description: URL to the agent's discovery profile.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the agent wants to negotiate.

authorization.title: Authorization Context
authorization.description: Authorization context for AXP requests, compatible with UCP's identity linking.

token.description: Authorization token (JWT for bearer, link token for identity_link).

identity_link_ref.description: Reference to UCP identity link if using linked identity.
